UPDATE conversations 
SET assigned_agent_id = (SELECT id FROM agents WHERE name LIKE '%Support%' AND name LIKE '%Tier 1%' LIMIT 1),
    agent_type = 'tier1'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.conversationId }}'::uuid
RETURNING *;

SELECT c.*, cust.name as customer_name, cust.email, cust.tier as customer_tier
FROM customers cust
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.customer_id = cust.id
WHERE cust.phone_number = '{{ $json.customerPhone }}'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT * FROM conversations 
WHERE customer_phone = '{{ $json.customerPhone }}'
  AND status = 'completed'
ORDER BY ended_at DESC
LIMIT 3;

INSERT INTO conversation_turns (id, conversation_id, turn_number, speaker, message, timestamp, metadata)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $('Build Support Context').item.json.conversationId }}'::uuid,
  1,
  'agent',
  '{{ $json.response }}',
  NOW(),
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ agent_type: "archie", model: "local" }) }}'::jsonb
);

INSERT INTO escalations (id, conversation_id, from_agent_id, to_agent_id, reason, priority, status, escalated_at)
VALUES (
  gen_random_uuid(),
  '{{ $('Build Support Context').item.json.conversationId }}'::uuid,
  (SELECT id FROM agents WHERE name LIKE '%Support%' AND name LIKE '%Tier 1%' LIMIT 1),
  (SELECT id FROM agents WHERE name LIKE '%Support%' AND name LIKE '%Tier 2%' LIMIT 1),
  '{{ $json.escalationReason }}',
  '{{ $json.confidence < 0.5 ? "high" : "medium" }}',
  'pending',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING *;

UPDATE conversations
SET status = 'escalated',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Build Support Context').item.json.conversationId }}'::uuid;
